■ Stage Direction
SE: Cheering

★ Request
Fade to black
It's one serving.

Since Oguri Cap had a mock race during class in the afternoon,
we decided to have lunch together, but...
...Thank you! I appreciate it.

If I go to the cafeteria, I end up eating without limit,
so sometimes I buy food at the school store like this.
I'm really glad I asked you to be my Trainer.

Thank you for the meal.
By the way, Trainer, did you make these by hand?

I was happy that my rice balls could become
a source of energy for Oguri Cap, but...

Her eyes sparkling, Oguri Cap picked up a rice ball
and began wolfing it down at an incredible pace.

...The people back home taught me most of the important things.
To repay their kindness, I have to keep growing at this academy.

And in the blink of an eye, she devoured
all three rice balls I had prepared.

No matter where you take a bite, you hit the filling right away,
which fills you with happiness.

Mmm... Just remembering it makes my stomach growl again...
I guess being eighty percent full wasn't quite enough.

I bought them at the school store.
This should keep your energy fully replenished.

It's been a while since I had such a comforting taste. My stomach and heart are both full.
Trainer, look forward to the mock race this afternoon!

I'd say I'm about eighty percent full.
If I eat too much, I won't be able to move.
...! Are you sure I can have this?

They're perfectly round and as big as shot puts,
wrapped in tender nori seaweed.

Tome-san taught me that saying "Itadakimasu," "Gochisousama,"
and chewing your food well to savor it is how you show gratitude to the cook.
(Grrruuuuuumble...)

The bag placed by her side was stuffed
with an absurd amount of rice balls and bread.

Having you by my side really gives me
that same comforting feeling as being back home.

...If it's not the technique, is there some other secret?
If it's alright with you, could you let me watch you make them next time?

Hrmm... Even if I go buy more,
would I make it back in time from the store...?

They're packed with fillings too, loaded with grilled pollack roe,
pickled mustard greens, and simmered kombu.

They're just like Tome-san's rice balls... gentle,
warm, and heart-soothing rice balls.
Of course.
(Grrrruuuumble...)

...Yeah. Speaking of Tome-san, the rice balls she often gave me
were so delicious. They were my absolute favorite.

I couldn't help but wish
she had left at least one for me, though.

Under the wide blue sky, the food vanished into Oguri Cap
as though being sucked into a black hole...

Ever since I came here, I've missed the taste of those rice balls.
I want to learn how to make them myself... Could you teach me?
Do you use some special shaping technique?
Fufu, then I won't hold back.

True to her word, Oguri Cap went on
to score an overwhelming victory in the mock race.

Laying out the food she had bought, Oguri Cap clasped her
hands together politely, said "Itadakimasu," and began eating.
Thank you for the meal.
